subject.title: Exploring a chat-first Android surface for OpenClaw (discussion + possible focused upstreaming)

question: Should the official Android app move toward a chat-first default/mode, accept focused UX/media PR slices while keeping Overview-first, or leave this as external fork territory for now?
rationale: Current main partially improves Android chat access, but changing the default surface or broad media scope affects onboarding, pairing, security, release posture, and Android product direction.

options.title: Scope focused Android PR slices
options.body: Keep the issue open for Android owners to define narrow launch/navigation, media, and connectivity slices with real-device proof before accepting implementation PRs.

options.title: Keep Overview-first for now
options.body: Document that the official app remains a Gateway companion with Overview-first navigation and ask contributors to keep chat-first forks external unless a specific defect is filed.

options.title: Sponsor a chat-first mode
options.body: Have maintainers explicitly sponsor a chat-first default or mode and require upgrade, onboarding, and media-permission proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Scope focused Android PR slices
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for Android owners to define narrow launch/navigation, media, and connectivity slices with real-device proof before accepting implementation PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android app is listed as @obviyus's area and the existing chat-entry behavior history points to the same owner boundary.
